summary: Huachen AI Parking Management Technology Holding Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a notice of an extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement. The meeting proposes increasing authorized share capital from US$78,125 to US$37,500,000 by creating new class A and B ordinary shares, adopting amended memorandum, and approving share consolidations up to 4000:1 over two years. No definitive price, premium, or transaction is stated. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping filing (authorized shares increase and consolidation authorization). No special-situation event is announced, and no value-changing corporate action is disclosed. Watch for future consolidation implementation.
